question: Should OpenClaw persist immutable root and lineage-specific chain IDs, or keep parent edges canonical and expose full-chain traversal as a derived API?
rationale: Current main already supports direct parent/depth lineage and child derivation, so the remaining choice changes persistent state and public API semantics rather than repairing an established broken contract.

options.title: Persist dedicated lineage
options.body: Define immutable root and chain ID semantics and apply them consistently across every spawn and authorized projection path.

options.title: Derive chain traversal
options.body: Keep parentSessionKey authoritative and add recursive traversal without redundant persisted identity.

options.title: Keep partial lineage
options.body: Retain current parent/depth metadata and leave complete chain reconstruction to external consumers.

recommendation.title: Persist dedicated lineage
recommendation.body: Define immutable root and chain ID semantics and apply them consistently across every spawn and authorized projection path.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue review and broad current ownership of the central session surfaces make steipete the strongest available decision owner.
